mintAuthority.summary: FUSD's reviewed EVM deployments on Ethereum, Avalanche, Sonic, and Monad share an issuer-administered uncapped gateway and zero-delay ProxyAdmin. The cataloged Solana mint has a verified 1-of-3 SPL Token multisig, but its liability identity is disputed: on-chain metadata names FinChain Dollar LP / FUSDLP, and issuer FUSD and FUSDLP pages both list that mint. Existing Solana control exposure is retained pending identity adjudication, not presented as an unambiguous FUSD native deployment. CCIP pools and TokenBridgeSender remain bridge machinery reviewed under bridgeRouteRisk.

review.evidence: Fresh 2026-10-02 pins at Ethereum 26103182, Avalanche 96586791, Sonic 80228511 and Monad 109835926 resolve every authored EVM token/gateway/sender implementation and admin slot. The sole token and gateway DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holder is the same codeless issuer EOA; ProxyAdmin.owner() is that EOA on all four chains, with immediate onlyOwner upgrades. Token MINTER_ROLE is fully enumerated: gateway, TokenBridgeSender and the already inventoried CCIP pools; no unidentified token minter is omitted. Gateway MINTER_ROLE separately grants the codeless 0x88a7141a3dd011e85ce5e18e4c7b679a6d9cd647 arbitrary fresh-message-ID minting on Avalanche, Sonic and Monad; Ethereum has none. Gateway PAUSER_ROLE has one shared holder, 0xa7b5849cdde66c5c998252a3d4c03e11573a900d. Finalized Solana slot 452544757 confirms the cataloged mint, freeze authority and initialized 1-of-3 SPL multisig, plus FinChain Dollar LP / FUSDLP metadata. The SPL Token ProgramData header at slot 452544947 has no upgrade authority. Both freshly fetched issuer token pages still list the same Solana mint; the liability question is confined to that exact Solana controller and remains open. No Solana exposure is removed and no deployment-local economic exclusion is claimed. Issuer inventory/NAV accounting and claimed prudential supervision are retained as qualified issuer disclosures, not independently verified financial assurance or regulatory authorization. Queue convergence review 2026-10-03 re-read the issuer FUSD and FUSDLP deployment pages: both still name Solana mint 51tpgun58apNKgrk96xAVUCN5yC7cDzt3EHov9UjBh3Q, so the retained pinned FUSDLP metadata conflict cannot honestly resolve its FUSD liability reach. The exact unresolved compiled fact is mint-meta:fusd-finchain:faff4face07e560f7df9.economicLossScope = unknown, from the fresh scoped question on the partial SPL multisig executionScope: the active solana-mint-authority path has unbounded cap and claim impairment but unknown reach and economicLossScope, with no proven global-claim mint path. adaptMintControl therefore retains unknown loss scope, and deriveV9MintPosture resolves that row to unknown before reconciliation credit. A11 requires the asset annotation to stay unknown rather than claim the EVM sibling's unbounded-reconciled posture. EconomicCapSemantics remains unbounded on the independently established EVM mint paths; no scope closure, liability attribution, or new on-chain observation is claimed.
